segments.text: Your to-do list is lying to you. It puts a tax deadline and 'water the plants' in the same font, like they weigh the same.
So before you start, put a letter on each task. A: serious consequences if you skip it. E: you could delete it and nothing happens.
Then the iron rule: never do a B while an A is still sitting there. No easy task before an important one.
Your A-1, the task with the biggest consequences, that's your frog. Start there, every single day.
